name: The Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad: Infernal Machine Properties

ddbimporter.parentName: The Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad

results.description: [[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])01 Beneficial PropertyYou have a flying speed of 150 feet but lose all other movement. Detrimental PropertyYou are blinded.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])02 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the speak with animals spell at will, but can use it to speak with only one animal of your choice. Detrimental PropertyAll animals despise you. You have disadvantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])03 Beneficial PropertyOne weapon or item you carry of your choice gains a walking speed of 30 feet and goes where you tell it. Detrimental PropertyYour armor and clothing feels unnaturally tight. Unless you go naked, roll a[[/r + 4]] eachtime you are attacked and subtract the number rolled from your AC.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])04 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the legend lore spell three times. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you make an Intelligence check or use divination magic to learn something about a creature, that knowledge comes with added trivia of the DM’s devising.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])05 Beneficial PropertyYou emanate a weak magnetic aura. The first time during a combat that a creature attacks you with a metal weapon, that creature has disadvantage on the attack roll. Detrimental PropertyMetal rusts in response to your touch—including metal armor you wear and metal weapons you hold—reproducing the effect of the [monster]rust monster;s;rust monster’s[/monster] Rust Metal trait.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])06 Beneficial PropertyYour fingers sprout tiny clockwork picks, granting you advantage on ability checks made using thieves’ tools or tinker’s tools. Detrimental PropertyAny metal object you wield or wear is covered in a thin layer of oil that drips occasionally and leaves your fingerprints everywhere.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])07 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the speak with animals spell at will, but can use it to communicate only with insects. Detrimental PropertyDisturbing whispers on the edge of hearing haunt all creatures within 30 feet of you, causing those creatures to recall their saddest memories.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])08 Beneficial PropertyYou have a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Insight checks) involving creatures you can see. Detrimental PropertyYour body is ghostly and translucent except for your bones. You have vulnerability to radiant damage, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls while in direct sunlight.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])09 Beneficial PropertyYou summon a unicorn that obeys your commands. If you give a command that violates the unicorn’s alignment, the unicorn immediately vanishes. Detrimental PropertyYou grow a unicorn horn.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])10 Beneficial PropertyA specialized clockwork compass floats in front of you. You can name one character, place, or object on the same plane as you and have the compass point constantly in the direction of the named target. You gain no knowledge of the distance to the target. Detrimental PropertyA specialized clockwork compass floats in front of you, and points toward you. The DM determines whether a creature currently looking for you is drawn to your location. Additionally, when a creature attacks you for the first time during an encounter, it has advantage on the attack roll.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])11 Beneficial PropertyYour clothes are wrapped in illusion that makes them appear to be the very latest style, drawing praise and attention. You have a +1 bonus to Charisma checks. Detrimental PropertyAny food and drink you eat spoils as you swallow it. Each time you eat or drink, you are poisoned for 1 hour.
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])12 Beneficial PropertyYou have a +1 bonus to attack rolls with weapons or spells (your choice). Detrimental PropertyThe cure wounds spell restores no hit points for you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])13 Beneficial PropertyYou have an innate sense of direction. You automatically succeed on ability checks made to avoid becoming lost. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you move, a magical voice calls out your direction and how far you’ve gone. The voice cannot be silenced or stopped.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])14 Beneficial PropertyYou constantly see afterimages of all events that occurred within 30 feet of you over the previous hour. Detrimental PropertyYou are distracted by voices and visions, forcing you to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw every 4 hours or gain one level of exhaustion.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])15 Beneficial PropertyYou understand all languages, as if under the effect of a comprehend languages spell. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you speak, you speak in a random language (possibly including languages you don’t normally know).
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])16 Beneficial PropertyYou have +1 bonus to initiative rolls. Detrimental PropertyYou are unable to hear any speech louder than a whisper.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])17 Beneficial PropertyAn exact duplicate of you appears next to you, dressed as you but lacking any gear. The duplicate functions as a familiar and has the statistics of a cat. Detrimental PropertyAn exact duplicate of you appears next to you, dressed as you but lacking any gear. It loudly tries to convince all other creatures that it is you, and you are its familiar. If destroyed, it reappears in[[/r 1d4]] hours.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])18 Beneficial PropertyWhile you are afflicted by a disease or suffering the poisoned or frightened condition, whenever you hit a humanoid with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, you transfer the disease or the condition to the target, and the disease or condition ends for you. Detrimental PropertyWater becomes intensely acidic to you. If you are submerged in water, you take [[/r 1d6[acid] # Acid damage]] damage at the start of each of your turns, and drinking pure water causes you to be poisoned for 1 hour.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])19 Beneficial PropertyA random Huge beast appears next to you (chosen by the DM) as if with the conjure animals spell. You have a telepathic link to this beast, such that you can give it commands even if it can’t hear you. Detrimental PropertyA random Huge beast appears next to you (chosen by the DM) and attacks at once.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])20 Beneficial PropertyYou have 1 luck point, which you can use as if you had taken the Lucky feat. If you have taken that feat, you have 1 extra luck point. Detrimental PropertyThose around you perceive you as dishonest, even when you are completely truthful. You automatically fail Charisma checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])21 Beneficial PropertyIf you drop to 0 hit points, a phantom guardian appears next to you, functioning as if you had cast the Mordenkainen’s faithful hound spell. The guardian disappears if you die, regain hit points, or regain consciousness. Detrimental PropertyNo one takes you seriously, imposing disadvantage on Charisma (Deception and Persuasion) checks, and causing you to automatically fail Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])22 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the gaseous form spell on yourself three times. When you do, instead of appearing as mist, you appear as a swirling puff of feathers. Detrimental PropertyYour body is covered in feathers.
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])23 Beneficial PropertyYou have advantage on death saving throws. Detrimental PropertyYou have disadvantage on all saving throws except death saving throws.
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])24 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast speak with animals at will, but can use it to communicate only with dogs. Detrimental PropertyAll cats are automatically hostile toward you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])25 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the raise dead spell once, requiring no material components. Detrimental PropertyIf you drop to 0 hit points, you automatically suffer 1 failed death saving throw.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])26 Beneficial PropertyEach time you finish a short rest, up to 100 silver pieces already in your possession become gold pieces, and up to 100 copper pieces become silver pieces. Detrimental PropertyAll coins you touch become worthless tin.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])27 Beneficial PropertyAnything poisonous within 50 feet of you is automatically detected and marked by the image of a small frog that is visible only to you. Detrimental PropertyA dozen small frogs constantly follow you around, chirping loudly.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])28 Beneficial PropertyYou gain the benefit of a nondetection spell. Detrimental PropertyYour appearance changes randomly as determined by the DM, as if you were under the effect of a disguise self spell.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])29 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the mage hand cantrip at will. Detrimental PropertyA disembodied spirit follows you around, stealing and scattering coins from you, crumbling your food, and playing with your weapons and gear.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])30 Beneficial PropertyYou are able to decipher any text. Detrimental PropertyYou lose the ability to speak any language. This has no effect on casting spells with verbal components.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])31 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the speak with plants spell three times. Detrimental PropertyYour skin turns green, and you must drink a half gallon of fresh water every 4 hours or take [[/r 1d4[necrotic] # Necrotic damage]] damage.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])32 Beneficial PropertyYou know whether creatures within 15 feet of you are lying, as if you were the center of a zone of truth spell. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you would speak falsely, you cannot speak at all.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])33 Beneficial PropertyYou gain a sense of destiny that directs you toward an important goal, as determined by the DM. Detrimental PropertyYour head is filled with an unpleasant buzzing that imposes disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])34 Beneficial PropertyAll creatures you speak with automatically believe your words, as if you have succeeded on a Charisma (Deception or Persuasion) check against them. Any sign of threatening or duplicitous action on your part negates this automatic success. Detrimental PropertyYour personal tastes reverse, such that your favorite foods, hobbies, music, and so forth become unbearable to you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])35 Beneficial PropertyYour shadow becomes an undead shadow that shares your alignment and is under your control. Detrimental PropertyYour shadow behaves disapprovingly whenever you’re not looking—stealing things, mocking you behind your back, taunting opponents or friends, and so on.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])36 Beneficial PropertyYour skin is covered by slime. You automatically succeed on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple. Detrimental PropertyYour skin is covered by slime. You must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw to sit down, open doors, and perform other mundane tasks of the DM’s determination.
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])37 Beneficial PropertyFlowers turn to face you as you pass them. Detrimental PropertyMundane animals can’t look at you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])38 Beneficial PropertyEach time you finish a short rest, you suddenly sprout a covering of fragrant leaves. The leaves fall off after[[/r 1d10]] minutes,revealing[[/r 1d6]] magicfruits that can be plucked from your head. Each fruit functions as a berry created with the goodberry spell. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you stop moving for 10 minutes or more, you discover that your boots or shoes have set down roots that must be pulled free with a successful DC 20 Strength check.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])39 Beneficial PropertyChoose a creature you can see. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or drop one item they are holding (DM’s choice). You can use this property three times. Detrimental PropertyEach time you roll a 1 on a Dexterity check, you drop one object you are holding (DM’s choice).

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])40 Beneficial PropertyA group of small forest animals appears and follows you everywhere, singing and dancing. These magical creatures can perform any task you desire that could be performed by a prestidigitation spell. Detrimental PropertyYou break out into song whenever you roll a 1 on any die.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])41 Beneficial PropertyYour possessions change their state or appearance at the DM’s determination, giving you hints of potential future events. For example, your sword might become suddenly bloodstained to warn of an upcoming combat encounter, your clothes might become damp to warn of a water-filled pit trap ahead, and so on. Detrimental PropertyYou take a -5 penalty to initiative rolls.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])42 Beneficial PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on a[[/r + 20]], youhave advantage on your next[[/r + 20]] roll. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on a[[/r + 20]], youhave disadvantage on your next[[/r + 20]] roll.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])43 Beneficial PropertyGrass, moss, and flowers instantly grow in your footsteps. You are also unaffected by [rule]difficult terrain[/rule] created by plants. Detrimental PropertyAny harm that befalls a plant you can see (a woodcutter sawing down a tree, a gardener pulling weeds, and so forth) fills you with a sadness that imposes disadvantage on ability checks for 1 minute.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])44 Beneficial PropertyYou automatically know the direction to the greatest danger within 500 feet of you. Detrimental PropertyYou leave a trail of black footprints that allow anyone to automatically follow you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])45 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the detect thoughts spell three times. Detrimental PropertyAll creatures within 30 feet of you automatically know your surface thoughts, as if having cast detect thoughts against you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])46 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the misty step spell three times. When you do, you must begin and end your teleportation in an area of shadow. Detrimental PropertyWhile in direct sunlight, you have disadvantage on attack rolls as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])47 Beneficial PropertyCreatures cannot gain advantage on attacks made against you as a result of another creature using the Help action. Detrimental PropertyYou have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])48 Beneficial PropertyYou have increased lung capacity, increasing your walking speed by 10 feet and letting you hold your breath for twice as long as normal. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you exert yourself by fighting, running, and so forth, you breathe out intermittent gouts of flame that deal [[/r 1d4[fire] # Fire damage]] damage to you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])49 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the daylight spell three times. Detrimental PropertyAn evil undead creature that comes within 30 feet of you for the first time is charmed by you until the end of your next turn.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])50 Beneficial PropertyWhen you touch a copper piece, it transmutes to become two copper pieces. You can duplicate a maximum of 1,000 coins this way. Detrimental PropertyFood doesn’t satiate you, and you must eat double the amount of food you normally eat to avoid feeling hungry.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])51 Beneficial PropertyYou shed light like a torch, as if you were the target of a light cantrip. Detrimental PropertyNo one else can take a short rest within 40 feet of you, as everything you say or do seems distracting to them.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])52 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the divination spell once. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you make an Intelligence check or saving throw, you receive a grim vision of the DM’s determination, imposing disadvantage on your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])53 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you can become incorporeal for 10 minutes, allowing you to move through other creatures and objects as if they were [rule]difficult terrain[/rule]. You take 5 ([[/r 1d10[force] # Force damage]]) damage if you end your turn inside an object. You can use this property once. Detrimental PropertyYour senses diminish as if the world were faded around you, imposing disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])54 Beneficial PropertyWhile you take a short rest, the area within 50 feet of you takes on the illusory appearance of a beautiful forest glade. Detrimental PropertyThe first time an ally you can see takes damage as a result of failing a saving throw, you take the damage instead of them.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])55 Beneficial PropertyAs a bonus action, you can choose one creature within 10 feet of you and know one secret about it, as determined by the DM. Detrimental PropertyThe remove curse, lesser restoration, and greater restoration spells have no effect on you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])56 Beneficial PropertyYou can predict the weather conditions for the next 24 hours with perfect accuracy. Detrimental PropertyA rain cloud follows you around, drizzling on you constantly even while indoors.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])57 Beneficial PropertyYou have telepathy out to a range of 120 feet. Detrimental PropertyYou hear the voices of creatures you can see in your head from time to time (as detailed by the DM), but you have no idea whether what you’re hearing is the truth or not.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])58 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast speak with animals at will, but you can use it to communicate only with goats. Any goat you speak with becomes charmed by you for 1 hour. Detrimental PropertyYou become distraught unless your clothing is all the same color, imposing disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks and saving throws.
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])59 Beneficial PropertyYou have resistance to fire damage. Detrimental PropertyYou gain no benefit from any potion.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])60 Beneficial PropertyYou have immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions. Detrimental PropertyYou can speak only in a monotone voice, imposing disadvantage on Charisma checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])61 Beneficial PropertyYou and each creature within 10 feet of you have resistance to necrotic damage. Detrimental PropertyAny Wisdom (Medicine) check you make or that is made to help you is made with disadvantage.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])62 Beneficial PropertyThe first creature you hit with a weapon attack on each of your turns takes [[/r 1d4[fire] # Fire damage]] damage at the start of its next turn. Detrimental PropertyYou are blinded while in bright light, and your shadow takes on a monstrous appearance.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])63 Beneficial PropertyNo creature can learn your alignment by magical means, and you have advantage on Charisma checks involving creatures that also share your alignment. Detrimental PropertyYou have disadvantage on Charisma checks involving creatures that do not share your alignment.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])64 Beneficial PropertyAs a bonus action, you cause yourself and a willing ally you can see to swap positions by teleportation. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on a[[/r + 20]] roll,you and an ally you can see swap positions by teleportation.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])65 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you cause [rule]difficult terrain[/rule] within 50 feet of you to become normal terrain. You can use this property three times. Detrimental PropertyEach time you move through [rule]difficult terrain[/rule], your speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])66 Beneficial PropertyYou increase one ability score of your choice by 2. You can increase an ability score above 20 using this property, but the increase is lost when this property ends. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw using your highest ability score, you take [[/r 1d4[psychic] # Psychic damage]] damage.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])67 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you learn the direction and distance to the nearest magic item not in the possession of you or any of your allies. Detrimental PropertyEach creature within 30 feet of you automatically knows which magic items you carry.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])68 Beneficial PropertyAs an action while you are in dim light or darkness, you can become invisible, as if targeted by the invisibility spell. In addition to becoming visible if you attack or cast a spell, you become visible if you move into bright light. You can use this property three times. Detrimental PropertyWhile in bright light, you have disadvantage on initiative rolls.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])69 Beneficial PropertyYou can read and understand all the languages commonly spoken within 1 mile of you, as determined by the DM. Detrimental PropertyWhile speaking, you occasionally use nonsense words, imposing disadvantage on Charisma checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])70 Beneficial PropertyYou know one cantrip of the DM’s choice, and can cast one 1st-level spell of the DM’s choice at will. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you cast a spell or use a magic item property that requires an action or a bonus action to activate, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (see the sorcerer section in chapter 3 of the Player’s Handbook) to see what happens.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])71 Beneficial PropertyWhenever you roll a 20 on a[[/r + 20]], youcan immediately end one effect on you. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on a[[/r + 20]], youare blinded until the end of your next turn.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])72 Beneficial PropertyAny clothing you wear is covered with a magical map image that shows all the local area you are aware of. This map doesn’t reveal anything you don’t know, but grants advantage on ability checks to find secret doors and to navigate back to where you’ve been. Detrimental PropertyAny rope you touch transforms into a poisonous snake that attacks you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])73 Beneficial PropertyYou summon a slithering tracker that obeys your commands. Detrimental PropertyYou take on the appearance of having translucent skin, with your bones and organs slightly visible within.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])74 Beneficial PropertyYou have a fresh-scrubbed appearance, and a sweet perfume surrounds you. You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you fail a Charisma (Persuasion) check, the subject of the check becomes irrationally resentful of you, seeking to undermine you in ways determined by the DM.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])75 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the control weather spell. Detrimental PropertyEach time you deal or take cold damage or fire damage, you must succeed on a DC 10 Charisma saving throw or accidentally summon a hostile air elemental or fire elemental (depending on the damage dealt).

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])76 Beneficial PropertyA tiny construct resembling a gynosphinx follows you around. It can truthfully answer up to ten yes-or-no questions regarding the campaign, at the DM’s discretion. Detrimental PropertyA tiny construct resembling a gynosphinx follows you around. It constantly asks unsolvable riddles of other creatures, and insults those creatures when they fail to answer correctly.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])77 Beneficial PropertyA creature appears next to you that is a hybrid of any two nonmagical beasts (akin to the owlbear). The creature serves you as if created by a conjure animals spell. The DM determines the creature’s statistics. Detrimental PropertyA creature appears next to you that is a hybrid of any two nonmagical beasts (akin to the owlbear). Unless you succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check, the creature attacks you before wandering off. The DM determines the creature’s statistics.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])78 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the teleport spell, always arriving on target when you do. You can use this property once. Detrimental PropertyEach time you walk through a doorway or similar portal, you must succeed on a DC 10 Intelligence check or step into a skewed timeline. On a failure, you and all allies within 10 feet of you skip ahead[[/r 1d4]] minutes. To other creatures, it appears that you and other affected creatures disappear for that length of time, then appear again in the doorway.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])79 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the haste spell on yourself. You can use this property three times. Detrimental PropertyEach time you are reduced to 0 hit points then stabilized, you suffer the effect of a slow spell.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])80 Beneficial PropertyYou do not need to breathe and cease to do so, making you immune to inhaled poisons and [rule]suffocating;suffocation[/rule]. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you speak (including casting a spell with a verbal component), you must first use a bonus action to breathe.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])81 Beneficial PropertyYour blood is venomous, granting you immunity to poison and to the poisoned condition. You can cast the speak with animals spell at will, but you can use it to communicate only with snakes. Detrimental PropertyYour tongue is long and forked, causing you to speak in a hiss. You have disadvantage on Charisma checks involving speech, and you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution check to cast a spell with a verbal component.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])82 Beneficial PropertyYou grow gills and have the ability to breathe air and water. You also sprout a pair of tentacles from your shoulders that have a reach of 10 feet and can be used to perform any action you could perform with your hands. The tentacles cannot attack or grapple. Detrimental PropertyYou are constantly followed by[[/r 1d4]] octopusesthat can breathe air and water, and which have a walking speed of 30 feet. Each time combat breaks out, you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check or have the octopuses panic and attack you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])83 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the misty step spell three times. When you do, you must begin and end your teleportation in an area of fire. Any fire damage you take during the same turn in which you use misty step is restored automatically at the end of your turn. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you start your turn within 30 feet of an ongoing fire effect, you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or move toward the fire and into it if possible.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])84 Beneficial PropertyWhen you look at the sky, you see it overlaid with navigational symbols. You have advantage on ability checks made to avoid becoming lost while outdoors. Detrimental PropertyYou have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while indoors.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])85 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the healing word spell three times. Detrimental PropertyUndead are drawn to you, making it impossible for you to hide from them. Each undead creature you face in combat has advantage on its first attack roll against you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])86 Beneficial PropertyAny food you touch is transformed into a culinary delight. You have advantage on Charisma checks while interacting with any creatures that have eaten of this food. Detrimental PropertyYou constantly hear distracting music that throws off your timing, imposing disadvantage on initiative rolls and Dexterity checks.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])87 Beneficial PropertyYour mind is filled with lost facts and lore, granting advantage on Intelligence checks. Detrimental PropertyYou forget your name, and must be constantly reminded of it by your allies.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])88 Beneficial PropertyYour touch can change small nonmagical objects into chocolate. Detrimental PropertyAnything you eat or drink makes you feel overly sated and full, imposing disadvantage on Strength checks for 1 hour.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])89 Beneficial PropertyEach time you finish a short rest, you regain[[/r 1d8]] hit points. Each creature that took a short rest with you and remained within 30 feet of you for the duration also gains this benefit. Detrimental PropertyEach time you finish a short rest, you take [[/r 3d8[psychic] # Psychic damage]] damage. At your determination, you can transfer some or all of this damage to any creatures that took a short rest with you and remained within 30 feet of you for the duration.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])90 Beneficial PropertyEach time you finish a short rest, you find[[/r 1d10]] smallgems worth 10 gp each in your possession. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you spend coins or gems, any character you give them to becomes convinced that the wealth was stolen from them.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])91 Beneficial PropertyWhen you hit a creature for the first time during an encounter, its Armor Class is reduced by 1. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on a weapon attack roll, the weapon shatters like glass. The weapon magically reforms in[[/r 1d4]] rounds.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])92 Beneficial PropertyEach time you enter a settlement, you are treated as though you are known there and a friend, even if you are neither. Detrimental PropertyEach time you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you grow one inch taller. Your clothing and armor does not grow with you.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])93 Beneficial PropertyWhile standing in a doorway, you can cast the teleport spell. Your destination must be another doorway you know. You can use this property once. Detrimental PropertyEach time you finish a short rest, you forget one of your allies (of the DM’s choice) and no longer trust that character. You lose this distrust at the end of your next short rest.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])94 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you cause a swirling storm of rocks and dust to surround you in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. Each creature hostile to you that enters the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take [[/r 1d6[bludgeoning] # Bludgeoning damage]] damage and be blinded for 1 round. You can use this property three times. Detrimental PropertyFire elementals, water elementals, and other creatures of fire and water (as determined by the DM) regard you as their enemy, and focus their attacks against you to the exclusion of all else.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])95 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you learn the names of every humanoid creature within 30 feet of you. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you roll a 1 on a Strength or Dexterity check that incorporates touching an object, you stick to that object for 1 minute. It takes a successful DC 20 Strength check to free yourself.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])96 Beneficial PropertyYou can cast the modify memory spell once. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you make an Intelligence check or saving throw, you must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or lose all your memories of the past hour.
[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])97 Beneficial PropertyYou can ignore the verbal component of any spell you cast. Detrimental PropertyYou must shout the verbal component of any spell you cast.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])98 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you conjure a mindless, shapeless force that is your exact duplicate. You control this force as if it were the product of an unseen servant spell, except that it is visible. Detrimental PropertyEach time you see your own reflection, you must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you treat your allies as enemies and vice versa for 1 minute, attacking the wrong targets, betraying your companions in social situations, and so forth. You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on a success.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])99 Beneficial PropertyAs an action, you can replace one of your hands with any nonmagical weapon, tool, or piece of adventuring equipment of reasonable size (as determined by the DM). Detrimental PropertyYour hands feel unnaturally large, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks using thieves’ tools or artisan’s tools. The first weapon attack roll you make in any encounter is made with disadvantage.

[[+ 100]] ([[/r + 100]])00 Beneficial PropertyAll creatures of a particular type other than humanoid (as chosen by the DM) are incapable of acting hostile toward you as long as you do not attack, threaten, or provoke them. Detrimental PropertyWhenever you meet a creature of a particular type other than humanoid (as chosen by the DM), there is a 1 percent cumulative chance that the tarrasque is magically summoned within 1 mile of you. The tarrasque has no knowledge of your existence. It runs amok for[[/r 1d6]]× 10 minutes, then magically returns to its previous location.
